authority.qualification: verified evidence linked to these ledgers; catalogue registration or historical complete flags are insufficient

authorization: Entire existing mathematics/jet scope. Representative GARCH/GJR work is a milestone, never Phase 1 closure.

closure_policy.scope_deletion: cannot establish success; retain original promises and audit any independently authorized change

gate_definitions.scope: Full promised scope and assertion/case coverage; no silent deletion or skip.
gate_definitions.independent_build: Python-free core/bridge, no legacy includes or libraries, audited linked owners.
gate_definitions.single_owner: One equation/layout/domain/map owner shared by runtime and all fixed paths.
gate_definitions.objective: Independent equations, constants, normalization, sample, histories, seed and units.
gate_definitions.derivatives: Local/recursive/complete theta AD and original-z AD with map curvature and all cross blocks.
gate_definitions.requests: All seven masks, full projection, validity reasons and untouched unrequested outputs.
gate_definitions.range: Theoretical/numerical/differentiability domains, genuine kinks, cancellation and long-horizon stress.
gate_definitions.preparation_memory: Request-order caches/lifetimes, caller arenas, checked overflow/overlap/alignment, no request allocation.
gate_definitions.fixed_runtime: Arbitrary/valid zero orders, every layout field, executed fixed dispatch and fallback metadata.
gate_definitions.references: Required reviewed AD plus independent values/reductions/MP; missing dependencies fail closed.
gate_definitions.production_binary: Production compiler/linker/contraction, backend ownership, frames <= 16384 bytes and binary size.
gate_definitions.request_performance: Repeated alternating paired F/G/H costs, consumed outputs, matched accuracy, attributed regressions.

parameter_layout_promises.ordering: mean block, volatility or constant innovation variance, density shape block; profile targets explicitly remove and reconstruct the variance nuisance
parameter_layout_promises.density_blocks: Use the density shape_names above; preserve GH fixed-lambda specialization identity.

sample_contracts.seeded_variance: Supplied positive finite h0, seeded finite histories, explicit first scored row/hold-back. No implicit volatility-order trimming or seed floor.
sample_contracts.constant_scale_mean: Explicit retained observations/design, inverse-MA history, scored rows, innovation variance and any independently declared profile.
sample_contracts.joint_mean_variance: Mean residuals feed volatility and density jointly; independently declared AR/HAR/MA histories, seed, hold-back and every cross block.
